title: Isolate responsibilities in the order service
difficulty_rationale: Splits one monolithic function across three new modules with specified interfaces and dependency rules, while preserving exact Decimal arithmetic and receipt formatting.
summary: process_order() validates, prices and formats in one function; split it into validation, pricing and receipt modules with specified interfaces.
required_behavior: orders.validation.validate_order(order) raises OrderError for invalid orders and returns None otherwise.
orders.pricing.price_order(order) returns a PricedOrder(subtotal, discount, tax, total) of Decimals, quantised to 0.01.
orders.receipt.format_receipt(order, priced) returns the receipt string.
orders.service.process_order(order) only orchestrates the three functions and returns exactly the same string as before.
pricing must not import receipt or service; validation must not import pricing, receipt or service.
OrderError remains importable from orders.service and orders.

acceptance_tests.description: Receipts identical to the original implementation for a set of orders.
Same OrderError messages for invalid orders.
price_order returns PricedOrder with Decimal fields.
Import rules between modules are respected.
process_order has at most 6 statements and delegates to all three functions.
